rule: Spring tides bloom salt-bloom in the tide-pools
texts: When a spring tide fills the tide-pools, salt-bloom blooms in the tide-pools.
Whenever a spring tide fills the tide-pools, salt-bloom grows in the tide-pools.
Salt-bloom is a pale crystalline crust.
Salt-bloom quickly dissolves into the seawater.

fields.sentence: When a spring tide fills the tide-pools, salt-bloom blooms in the tide-pools.
parse: (: spring_tide_fills_bloom (Implication (And (Member $t spring_tide) (Member $e1 fill) (Agent $e1 $t) (Patient $e1 sk_tide_pools_1)) (And (Member (sk_bloom $e1) bloom) (Patient (sk_bloom $e1) salt_bloom) (Location (sk_bloom $e1) sk_tide_pools_1) (During (sk_bloom $e1) $e1))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: a bare MASS-NOUN subject inside a whenever-rule consequent ("salt-bloom blooms in the tide-pools"): the bare-kind-filler licence is stated for non-specific OBJECTS ('pays tax', 'grows wheat') and bare-plural subjects mint group witnesses, but nothing licenses (or forbids) a bare mass kind symbol as the per-occurrence subject of the derived event

no namespace separation between a verb-derived event class and a same-spelled noun kind: mandatory compound decomposition gives (Inheritance salt_bloom bloom) while the verb 'blooms' lemmatizes to the same event class in (Member (sk_bloom $e1) bloom), so every derived blooming event also becomes a member of the noun-kind salt_bloom inherits from — both atoms are individually required by the instruction set
review.notes: Routing is correct (indefinite trigger subject sends bare 'when' to the whenever machinery even with a definite object), the definite plural 'the tide-pools' takes a top-level GroupOf witness that legitimately licenses the sk_* constant appearing in the premise, and it is reused for coreference in the consequent's Location. All three compound genera are emitted with their noun modifiers withheld, and fill/bloom take Patient by the change-of-state tests.

fields.sentence: Whenever a spring tide fills the tide-pools, salt-bloom grows in the tide-pools.
parse: (: whenever_tide_fills_bloom (Implication (And (Member $t spring_tide) (Member $f fill) (Agent $f $t) (Patient $f sk_pools_1)) (And (Member (sk_grow $f) grow) (Patient (sk_grow $f) salt_bloom) (Location (sk_grow $f) sk_pools_1) (During (sk_grow $f) $f))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: a bare MASS-noun subject of a specific / per-occurrence clause ("salt-bloom grows in the tide-pools"): the instruction set fixes the bare kind filler for non-specific OBJECTS and a group witness for bare-plural SUBJECTS, but never says whether a bare mass subject takes a witness (here a per-occurrence Skolem one) or the bare kind symbol
review.notes: Compound handling is correct throughout: head genus only for tide_pool, spring_tide and salt_bloom, with the noun modifiers tide/spring/salt left unexposed; the definite plural takes a group witness and the per-occurrence Skolem event is During-tied to its trigger. The sk_pools_1 constant in the premise is licensed because a top-level fact asserts it.

fields.sentence: Salt-bloom is a pale crystalline crust.

review.notes: Fusing "crystalline crust" (structural/material adjective) while leaving colour "pale" as its own atom matches the term-of-art vs incidental-description line, and no transitive (Inheritance salt_bloom crust) is emitted. Borderline: this reads as a definitional gloss of the kind, so the genus claim arguably takes the taxonomic 1.0/0.99 rather than the empirical 0.9/0.9 chosen here, though 'when unsure, empirical' covers the choice.

fields.sentence: Salt-bloom quickly dissolves into the seawater.

q1_issues.issue: A bare mass/kind subject with a habitual simple present is a verbal generic, which the instruction set routes to an Implication rule giving each instance its own Skolem event, but the parse emits a flat event bundle instead.
The bare kind symbol salt_bloom fills the Patient role slot of that flat event, putting a class where the generic rule would bind an instance variable.
The event atoms carry the default (STV 1.0 0.99) rather than the empirical-generic 0.9 0.9 the generic reading requires.

q2_gaps: the medium/endpoint "into"-PP of a dissolution verb ("dissolves into the seawater"): the motion-result Goal presupposes an intact object relocated along a path, while the change-of-kind/phase rule explicitly bars a spatial Goal for "into" and expects the complement to name a state the subject becomes — neither fits a substance dispersing into a medium
review.notes: The compound decompositions are right (salt_bloom genus bloom, solid-spelled seawater genus water, noun modifiers salt/sea correctly unexposed) and "quickly" keeps its surface adverb form under Manner. Dissolve as an intransitive change-of-state undergoer correctly takes Patient rather than Agent.

issues.reason: 'Salt-bloom quickly dissolves into the seawater' is a habitual-present characteristic claim with a bare kind subject, which Quantifiers, generics & scope routes to a rule giving each instance its own Skolem event ('a verbal generic or universal over a kind becomes a rule'), not to a flat event bundle.

The half that stands is that the generic rule would bind an instance variable in that slot; the half that does not is that a bare class symbol in a role slot is illicit in itself - the Existential section reserves exactly that filler for non-specific / generic arguments ('cooked dinner').

A contingent generalization about a substance is empirical, so it takes 0.9 strength / 0.9 confidence per Confidence - definitional vs empirical; the individual-fact default 1.0 0.99 over-asserts a claim that admits counterexamples.

new_gaps: the instruction set gives two competing encodings for a bare-kind-subject habitual clause - 'an event with no status predicate is generic / habitual / dispositional' (Status predicates) versus 'a verbal generic over a kind becomes a rule' (Quantifiers) - and states no tie-breaker between the flat dispositional bundle and the distributing rule
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form is the verbal-generic rule (: sb_dissolve (Implication (Member $x salt_bloom) (And (Member (sk_dissolve $x) dissolve) (Patient (sk_dissolve $x) $x) (Manner (sk_dissolve $x) quickly) (Goal (sk_dissolve $x) sk_seawater_1))) (STV 0.9 0.9)), with the instance variable replacing the bare kind in the Patient slot. The empirical-generic 0.9 0.9 rides that one rule atom, while the two genus atoms and the definite seawater witness stay top-level facts at 1.0 0.99.
adjudication.notes: The reviewer's 'into'-PP gap is not confirmed: obliques are chosen by the question the PP answers, and 'into the seawater' answers whither, so Goal is licensed without invoking the resultative or change-of-phase rules.
